infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: KEKE uses your location to share your live position with the company during an active trip.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: KEKE shares your location with the company while a trip is active, even when the app is in the background.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: KEKE shares your location with the company while a trip is active, even when the app is in the background.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: KEKE Manager uses the camera for odometer photos at tour start and end, plus profile and vehicle photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: KEKE needs access to your photo library to upload profile photos, vehicle photos, and verification documents.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: KEKE Manager sends booking and driver notifications
